C1663.title: Sleep Function Resource Exhaustion Attack Disrupts AI Large Model Training
C1663.summary: In a domestic AI large model training security incident disclosed in October 2024, attackers maliciously used Sleep functions to suspend training tasks, causing a drastic drop in GPU utilization with a compute-to-idle ratio reaching 1:1 and severely wasting expensive computing resources.
